requirements.text: POST /orders must accept customerId and one or more lines, each containing sku and a positive quantity.
The service must reject any order line whose SKU is unknown or whose quantity is zero or negative.
On success, the service must create an order with status CREATED, calculate the sum of line totals, and emit order.created with the new order identifier.

sources.text: CreateOrderService.create validates the customer and validates that lines have known SKUs and positive quantities before saving an Order.created instance and publishing OrderCreated with the saved order id.
The supplied diff has no approval or retention branch.

warnings.text: Manager approval is unspecified and must not be inferred as a requirement.
Retention period is unspecified and must not be inferred as a requirement.
